nodes.message:
Make install safe; stamp the version; tighten CI

- make install links where gh actually keeps extensions
  (XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share), not GH_DATA_DIR, which gh ignores
  for extensions.
- It checks that INSTALL_DIR ends in gh-dojo before touching anything,
  only replaces an extension that does not already point at
  INSTALL_DIR, prints what it removed, and parks the old one aside so it
  is restored if the install fails.
- build and install stamp `git describe --always --dirty` into the
  binary.
- CI runs on pushes to main and on pull requests only, and checks gofmt
  and go mod tidy -diff.

Refs #1
Refs #2

Build commands under recover; reject duplicates and unknown subcommands

- run takes the root constructor and builds it under the deferred
  recover, so a panic in a constructor is a short internal error.
- register/registerAll take constructors that return an error; a
  constructor error (e.g. a broken dojo.toml) is printed through render
  instead of panicking or being dropped.
- Two commands with the same name or alias (including "help") are a
  usage error instead of one silently shadowing the other.
- Command groups reject unknown subcommands with a usage error and
  print their help without RunE; `gh dojo help <unknown>` fails too.
- `gh dojo --version` prints the version stamped with -ldflags, "dev"
  when unset.
- Comment that panics in goroutines are not caught.

Refs #1
Refs #2

Harden render errors, confirmations and golden updates

- Unknown GraphQL error types print "GitHub API rejected the request";
  the raw message stays only in Cause. Messages mentioning node IDs
  (PVTF_..., legacy base64 IDs) fall back to generic text.
- All GraphQL errors are checked: rate limit, then scopes/forbidden,
  then not found.
- HTTP 403 with Retry-After or a rate limit message is a rate limit
  (code 4, no auth fix).
- context.Canceled maps to code 4; typed-nil *Error is an internal error
  instead of a crash.
- Text drops blank lines before the 3-line limit, puts each allowed
  value on one line, clips at grapheme boundaries (uniseg) and never
  cuts the fix line (a fix over 400 runes is dropped).
- New Internal constructor: "internal error (not your arguments)" with a
  side-effect-free fix hint.
- Confirm(subject, title, effects...) shortens only the title; effects
  are never cut. Transition handles empty statuses.
- Golden files are rewritten only via UPDATE_GOLDEN, refused when CI is
  set.
- go.mod: go 1.27, uniseg as a direct dependency.

Refs #1
Refs #2

Add internal/render: exit codes, short errors, confirmations, truncation

render.Error carries an exit code (0-5 as in the spec), what is wrong,
allowed values and a fix command, and prints as at most 5 lines with no
traces or raw GraphQL. FromError maps go-gh HTTP/GraphQL and network
errors to codes 3/4 and anything else to a one-line usage error.

The top-level run() recovers panics into the same short error, silences
cobra's own output and turns flag, Args and unknown-command errors into
usage errors (code 1) pointing at --help.

Also add the confirmation-line, warning and "showing N of M" helpers, and
internal/testutil.Golden for golden-file tests across packages.

Refs #2

Add Go module skeleton, cobra root and gh extension install

Set up the gh-dojo module with a cobra root command in cmd/gh-dojo and a
registration pattern: each command lives in its own file and registers its
constructor from init, so new commands never touch root.go.

make install builds into ~/.local/share/gh-dojo/gh-dojo and installs the
extension from there, so the installed gh dojo does not depend on the
branch checked out in the working copy. CI runs vet, test and build.

Refs #1
